description: Scoring profile for ISO 9001 / AS9100 Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, and QMS roles.

fit_terms.pattern: \bquality engineer\b|\bquality manager\b|\bquality systems engineer\b|\bquality assurance engineer\b

test_cases.title: AS9100 Quality Engineer – Aerospace Manufacturing
test_cases.description: Lead AS9100 quality engineering activities including FAI, PPAP, root cause analysis, CAPA, supplier quality, and production quality support for aerospace components.
test_cases.rationale: Exact target role combining AS9100, FAI, PPAP, supplier quality, and aerospace manufacturing.

test_cases.title: Supplier Quality Engineer – Precision Machining
test_cases.description: Manage supplier development, PPAP submissions, machining quality, GD&T reviews, and corrective actions for precision aerospace components.
test_cases.rationale: Strong supplier quality role with machining, PPAP, GD&T, and aerospace alignment.

test_cases.title: Quality Manager – ISO 9001 Manufacturing
test_cases.description: Oversee ISO 9001 QMS, internal audits, CAPA, production quality, and continuous improvement initiatives.
test_cases.rationale: High-fit ISO 9001 quality management role with strong QMS and CI overlap.

test_cases.title: Quality Technician – Manufacturing
test_cases.description: Perform inspections, measurements, and basic quality checks.
test_cases.rationale: Low seniority and limited QMS/AS9100 responsibilities.
